harness_history: First run exit 0, initial JSON preserved. Baseline R16 already included omitted channel/pass categories, so provisional R34 was reclassified as R16; only research attribution changed, final run exit 0. Application unchanged.
boundaries: Schema-checked in-memory scalar fields/filter/select and transaction rollback, not Prisma/SQL/FK enforcement.
Actual public channel header function executed; video aggregate and non-main-channel resolution are explicit fakes; no browser/HTTP/cache.
Synthetic identities/providers only; no production, actual Stripe/Resend or email delivery.
Retention update counts use modeled rows, not actual AuditLog trigger privileges or scheduled execution.
Collector processBeacon executed, not collector HTTP/Next proxy/PostgreSQL or real daily salt deletion.
R16 is parse/query architecture evidence, not a measured memory exhaustion result.
Export omissions describe functionality and scope, not a legal finding of GDPR violation.

peertube_partial_review.scope: Selected request/validation/ownership/quota/JWT, job/archive states and domain exporters, expiry scheduler and best-effort file removal, User→Account→VideoChannels hooks, tests for channel/archive/expiry assertions. Not whole files or whole privacy audit.
positive_reference_patterns: Domain-specific categories including channels and settings
limitations_observed: Export model save and queue insert are separate steps; no demonstrated atomic outbox
Comments findAll, appendJSON stringify and accumulated AP outbox still use memory
File-removal hook catches failures asynchronously; no proof no orphan files remain
Federation Delete hooks do not prove every remote copy is removed
